## Purpose
Git hooks that make docgen READMEs load-bearing in practice — currently the `pre-push` hook that auto-refreshes READMEs after every user push, plus its end-to-end test suite.

## Files
- `pre-push` — Bash `git pre-push` hook (marker `DOCGEN_PRE_PUSH_HOOK_v1`). Forks a detached background worker that waits 5s, computes the changed-dir scope from the push's `remote_sha..HEAD` range (read from stdin), runs `docgen --until-done --parallel 4 --scope <dirs>`, commits `*README.md` + `.docgen/state.json`, and pushes back to the same branch with `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1` to break the loop. If the branch is gone server-side (PR already merged + deleted), opens a follow-up PR via `gh pr create` off a fresh `docgen/refresh-<ts>` branch. Locates `docgen` via `$DOCGEN_BIN` → PATH → sibling-of-this-script. Logs to `/tmp/docgen-push-hook.log` (overridable via `DOCGEN_HOOK_LOG_FILE`).
- `pre-push.test.mjs` — `node --test` end-to-end suite. Builds a self-contained env per test (tmp bare remote + working clone + vendored docgen at `tools/claude-code-auto-documentation/` + stub `claude` binary on PATH emitting a fixed README), installs the hook via the real `install-push-hook.sh`, then runs real `git push` and asserts on resulting remote state. Covers: loop-guard noop under `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1`, and cold-push triggering a detached refresh that auto-pushes README updates without looping.

## Dependencies / collaborators
- `../docgen` — the binary the background worker invokes; located via `$DOCGEN_BIN`, PATH, or sibling lookup from `BASH_SOURCE`.
- `../install-push-hook.sh` — installer that drops a shim at `.git/hooks/pre-push` pointing back to this `pre-push`; the test suite exercises it directly.
- `../inject-readme-context.mjs` — sibling PreToolUse hook for README injection (not in this dir but part of the same hook family described in the parent README).
- `.docgen/state.json` at repo root — state file the hook stages alongside refreshed READMEs.
- `gh` CLI — required for the follow-up-PR fallback path; absent → doc commit stays local.

## Gotchas
- Loop prevention is purely env-var-based: `DOCGEN_HOOK_SKIP=1` at the top of `pre-push` makes it exit 0 immediately, and the background worker sets that var before its own `git push`. Removing the guard or the env propagation re-introduces an infinite push loop.
- The hook always exits 0 in the foreground — failures (missing `docgen`, failed commit, failed push) are silent to the user and only surface in `/tmp/docgen-push-hook.log`. Debugging requires tailing that file.
- The diff-range fallback chain is `stdin-derived remote_sha..HEAD` → `@{push}..HEAD` → `HEAD~1..HEAD` → full walk. The last per-commit fallback is lossy on multi-commit pushes; the stdin path is the only fully accurate one and depends on the parent process correctly passing `DOCGEN_HOOK_PUSH_RANGE` into the backgrounded self-call.
